hypotheses.C1_earlier_operator_is_top_decile_forwar: L2H5 transplanted into L3H8 is in the best decile of all matched learned-operator controls on both halves.
hypotheses.C2_later_operator_is_not_reverse_compati: L3H8 transplanted into L2H5 is no better than the control median on both halves.
hypotheses.C3_directional_asymmetry_is_large: The percentile gap between transplant directions is at least 0.30 on both halves.
hypotheses.C4_both_transplants_beat_deletion: Both partner operators remain less harmful than deleting the target operator on both halves.
hypotheses.C5_complete_census_is_split_stable: Partner percentiles differ by at most 0.15 between halves for each direction.
